name: handler-tracksamples-root
description: Root workspace orchestrator for Handler TrackSamples

scripts.install:all: cd backend && pnpm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,REACT,ELECTRON" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:react" "npm run start:electron"
scripts.start:full: npx concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,REACT,ELECTRON" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:react" "npm run start:electron"
scripts.start:no-db: npx concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,REACT,ELECTRON" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:react" "npm run start:electron"
scripts.start:web: npx concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,FRONT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:react"
